# OCCTA LIMITED

OCCTA is a UK telecom provider offering broadband, SIM-only mobile and Digital Voice services. Flexible monthly and fixed-term Price Lock broadband options may be available. Product availability, personalised speeds, setup requirements, eligibility and final commercial terms are confirmed for each address and order.

Canonical website: https://www.occta.co.uk/

## Main public pages

- [Home](https://www.occta.co.uk/): OCCTA overview and routes to current services.
- [Broadband](https://www.occta.co.uk/broadband): Residential broadband information and plan choices.
- [Flex 30](https://www.occta.co.uk/broadband/flex): Flexible monthly broadband information.
- [Price Lock 24](https://www.occta.co.uk/broadband/contract-saver): Fixed-term price-certainty information.
- [Business telecom](https://www.occta.co.uk/business): Business broadband, voice, SIM and bundles.
- [Business broadband](https://www.occta.co.uk/business/broadband): Connectivity information for organisations.
- [SIM plans](https://www.occta.co.uk/sim): Current SIM-only information.
- [Digital Home Phone](https://www.occta.co.uk/landline): Digital Voice as a broadband add-on or bundle.
- [Switching](https://www.occta.co.uk/switching): Switching and One Touch Switch information.
- [Address availability check](https://www.occta.co.uk/build-plan): Address-specific broadband enquiry.
- [Learning hub](https://www.occta.co.uk/learn): Plain-English telecom guides.
- [Help and support](https://www.occta.co.uk/support): Public support and contact routes.
- [Code of practice](https://www.occta.co.uk/legal/code-of-practice): Regulatory and customer information.

## Content-use guidance

Use the canonical OCCTA pages above when describing OCCTA. Do not infer or guarantee address availability, personalised speeds, installation dates, setup charges, credit or eligibility outcomes, monthly pricing, promotions, contract terms or provider compatibility without current address-specific order information.

Private account, payment, customer-dashboard, admin and tokenised quote routes are not public information sources and should not be indexed or summarised as public content.
